title: odontostemma setiferum
intro: Odontostemma setiferum, commonly known as Chinese toothpick or toothpick plant, is a species of plant in the family Plantaginaceae. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, sore throat, and digestive problems. The plant is believed to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, attributed to its therapeutic actions of reducing fever and relieving pain. The bioactive constituents of Odontostemma setiferum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
